Resolves #15097

The Portal's old training and consulting offers become **Connect**, with practical links to create an app, explore agent memory and join public development. Header, footer and SEO use the same name while retaining `/services`. Cards wrap at narrow widths and links have visible keyboard focus. The existing animated background remains.

The rendered metadata check also exposed an existing `DocumentHead` defect: description and canonical setters passed flat descriptors to `setTag({value})`. Both now use the existing envelope, preserving the remote API and updating tags in place.

Evidence: L3 real Portal browser journeys at desktop and narrow widths, plus L2 generator and metadata controls. Required: L3 for this source change. Production release and Pages deployment are not claimed.

## Deltas from ticket
The operator requested AI-era next steps. The Connect cards therefore link existing public tools as well as community participation. GitHub is the verified community door; no new chat-channel or service-response promise is made. Existing global social links are outside this page replacement. The `DocumentHead` envelope repair is necessary for the metadata acceptance check and covers the identical canonical-helper defect. No API or topology change. Regenerating the old tracked LLM index also applies the generator's already-established curated default: raw issue/PR/discussion archives leave this index, reducing it from 18,218 to 549 lines. This changes no generator archive policy.

### 🧠 Graph Ingestion Notes

*   **`[KB_GAP]`**: `DocumentHead.setTag` takes `{value: {tag, ...attributes}}`, the remote-method envelope. Its own sibling setters had passed flat descriptors since they were written. A remote method whose payload shape differs from its siblings' fails silently: `value` defaults to `{}`, and nothing throws.
*   **`[TOOLING_GAP]`**: The hosted reds the receipt names, Gallery/native-hit and `CalendarMonthEventDrag`, are the known readiness flakes; the latter's fix rides in #20404. This PR changes neither surface.
*   **`[RETROSPECTIVE]`**: A real-browser metadata assertion found a production defect that unit coverage had missed, because the units never called the setters through their remote envelope.
